name: Roschenn
source:
The current Headmaster of Lumens Academy, Roschenn is a wise scholar who has overseen many bright students including the Imperial Family.

In his spare time, he writes romance adventure novels under the nom de plume, "Penrose", which are favored by many across the Empire.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/teamgalens/status/1666127817749434369]Twitter[/url]]
